title: Contemporary Challenges in Global Development
description: A critical review of contemporary challenges in global development, including a selection of topics related to key areas of focus for official development assistance such as foreign aid, poverty alleviation and development; gender, human rights and democracy; environmental sustainability and public health; transnationalism, migration and mobility; conflict and displacement; food security, water and energy resources; Indigenous issues; and struggles and development challenges in the Global South.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GEOG 333, GDS 202, GDS 300, GEOG 347B.
recommendations: It is recommended that students declared in the GDS minor take GDS 201 as the prerequisite to satisfy the GDS program requirement.
